test_title: PYST 53: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 9th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'RHINO' is written as 'POJIS' and 'TIGER' is written as 'SFHJU'. How will 'HORSE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8455c0124707b57e9f800e56eb0150ffa573557ee5dad7bdd2e126a53d24539f.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'RHINO' is written as 'POJIS'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ac34a9ecbd501fc7f69cc9c9c92d0e3f4686d693f9b72cada139178c77088c5.png] 

 

And

'TIGER' is written as 'SFHJU'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec0f47ad87b4a3e0e3abee83e834717dce15cf1052d8f3426a915c3d70a39115.png] 

Similarly,

'HORSE' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7dad6e3006844dfbb06f81cd392378d5edeb4c32d9de3249803ee21e776d77f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"FTSPI".**
